model: Original Registry -> Applied JEM Changes -> Effective Gameplay Behavior

precedence.order: priority ascending, selector specificity ascending, change_id ascending
precedence.conflict_policy: Equal-order modifiers of one property are reported; history and base facts are never overwritten.
